description.zh: 按一下快捷键，当前窗口就一直显示在其他窗口上面，再按一下取消；也可以在搜索框里输入“置顶”挑一个窗口。管理员身份运行的窗口改不了
description.en: One shortcut keeps the window in front above the others, and takes it off again; or type “top” in the search box and pick a window. Not for windows run as administrator

notes.zh: 置顶的窗口边上会有一圈强调色的细线，一眼看出哪些窗口在最前：跟着窗口移动、缩放，圆角窗口按圆角画，最大化时画在工作区边上，全屏时不画；窗口取消置顶或关闭后线就消失。不想要可以在插件卡片上关掉。已关闭或被别的程序取消置顶的窗口不再一直记着。权限不变。
notes.en: A window kept on top shows it: a thin accent-coloured line just inside its edge, round where the window is round, on the work area's edge when maximized, none in full screen; it follows the window and goes once the window comes off the top or closes. A setting on the plugin's card turns it off. Windows that closed or were taken off the top by another program are forgotten instead of kept until the plugin stops. Permissions unchanged.
